critic_risk_flags: Although H maps directly to the hospitalization-rate target, an explicit H compartment is flagged as weakly identifiable for short single-season series. SEIHR adds extra transition rates (e.g., I→H, H→R) that can confound with transmission and recovery, risking unstable fits without clear additional signal in 31 weeks.

I+H is not well-aligned to an admissions-focused hospitalization-rate target and can blur interpretation/scale (mixing prevalence-like and admissions/severity-like components). It also inherits SEIHR identifiability risks while adding an additional observation mixture that can be hard to disentangle in short data.
